name: Time Lord Regeneration — lists Time Lords and changelings
notes: "Target Time Lord you control": the creature type of two words (CR 205.3m) is one subtype in filters as on the type line. With Scryfall's catalog, where Time Lord is one entry, the picker listed nobody.

scryfallData.name: Susan Foreman
scryfallData.oracle_text:
If you would planeswalk, instead look at the top two cards of your planar deck, put one on the bottom of your planar deck and the other on top, then planeswalk.

scryfallData.name: Time Lord Regeneration
scryfallData.oracle_text: Until end of turn, target Time Lord you control gains "When this creature dies, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a Time Lord creature card. Put that card onto the battlefield and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order."
